description: Launch the browser with a persistent profile (headed by default; pass headless:true for headless). With cdp_port: attach to a Chromium/Electron app started by this server's mac_app launch cdp_port (needs NORACU_ALLOW_CDP=1; attaching to any other loopback port needs NORACU_ALLOW_CDP=any; refused under NORACU_READ_ONLY=1 and while another session is open; standalone browser_launch is also refused while a CDP session is open). browser_close then only disconnects.
name: browser_launch
